# Fix the regex in new_content
import re as re_module

# Correct regex pattern
correct_regex = '''_REGEX = re.compile(
        r"""
        ^
        (?P<major>(?:0|[1-9][0-9]*))
        \\.
        (?P<minor>(?:0|[1-9][0-9]*))
        \\.
        (?P<patch>(?:0|[1-9][0-9]*))
        (\\-(?P<prerelease>
            (?:0|[1-9A-Za-z-][0-9A-Za-z-]*)
            (\\.(?:0|[1-9A-Za-z-][0-9A-Za-z-]*))*
        ))?
        (\\+(?P<build>
            [0-9A-Za-z-]+
            (\\.[0-9A-Za-z-]+)*
        ))?
        $
        """, re.VERBOSE)'''

# Replace the broken regex in new_content
broken_start = new_content.find('_REGEX = re.compile(')
if broken_start >= 0:
    # Find the end of the regex assignment (the closing parenthesis and comma)
    # It ends with '""", re.VERBOSE)'
    end_marker = '", re.VERBOSE)'
    end_idx = new_content.find(end_marker, broken_start) + len(end_marker)
    
    new_content_fixed = new_content[:broken_start] + correct_regex + '\n' + new_content[end_idx:]
    
    # Verify the fix
    test_re = re_module.compile(r"""
        ^
        (?P<major>(?:0|[1-9][0-9]*))
        \.
        (?P<minor>(?:0|[1-9][0-9]*))
        \.
        (?P<patch>(?:0|[1-9][0-9]*))
        (\-(?P<prerelease>
            (?:0|[1-9A-Za-z-][0-9A-Za-z-]*)
            (\.(?:0|[1-9A-Za-z-][0-9A-Za-z-]*))*
        ))?
        (\+(?P<build>
            [0-9A-Za-z-]+
            (\.[0-9A-Za-z-]+)*
        ))?
        $
        """, re.VERBOSE)
    
    print("Testing fixed regex:")
    print(f"  '1.2.3': {test_re.match('1.2.3')}")
    print(f"  '1.0.0-rc1': {test_re.match('1.0.0-rc1')}")
    print(f"  '1.2.3-alpha.1.2+build.11.e0f985a': {test_re.match('1.2.3-alpha.1.2+build.11.e0f985a')}")
    
    # Save fixed content
    with open('semver.py', 'w') as f:
        f.write(new_content_fixed)
    print("File saved.")
else:
    print("ERROR: Could not find regex start!")
